item.title: [TESTDATEN] Testlampe TL-1: motion-sensor desk lamp now available for €89
item.description: TESTDATEN – fiktive Produktmeldung. The Testlampe TL-1 is a compact desk lamp with a built-in motion sensor: it switches on when someone sits down and dims to 10 percent after two minutes without movement. The aluminium arm folds flat, the warm-white LED panel offers three brightness levels, and a USB-C port powers it from a laptop charger. The fictional maker Muster-Testmarke A says the lamp is now available for €89 in two colours.

item.title: [TESTDATEN] Tragbarer Testmixer TM-300: cordless blender for smoothies on the go
item.description: TESTDATEN – fiktive Produktmeldung. The Testmixer TM-300 is a portable, battery-powered blender with a 400 ml bottle that doubles as a drinking cup. Six stainless-steel blades handle frozen fruit, a magnetic safety lock stops the motor when the lid is open, and one charge is rated for about fifteen blends. Pre-order is open now; the device is priced at $49 and is said to ship in December.

item.title: [TESTDATEN] Multifunktionaler Test-Organizer: modular desk organizer with wireless charging pad
item.description: TESTDATEN – fiktive Produktmeldung. The Test-Organizer MO-5 combines a pen holder, a cable tray, a drawer for small parts and a phone stand with a wireless charging pad in one bamboo frame. The modules click together magnetically, so the layout can be rearranged without tools. The announcement does not mention a price or a retailer.

item.title: [TESTDATEN] Kompakte Testkamera KX-2 – mysterious teaser leaves questions open
item.description: TESTDATEN – bewusst unklare fiktive Meldung. A short teaser shows what looks like a pocket-sized camera called KX-2 with a flip-up screen and a clip mount. It is unclear whether this is a finished device, a prototype or just a rendering, and the teaser gives no specifications. Some readers expect it to launch next year; others think it might only be a design study.

item.description: TESTDATEN – fiktive Konzeptmeldung.
